cohort: 66 patients with twin pregnancies and GDM from one maternal-fetal medicine practice from 2005 to 2014.
finding: In twin pregnancies complicated by GDM, improved glycemic control was not associated with improved outcomes and may be associated with a higher risk of SGA.
birth_weight: Smaller twin birthweight: GDMA1 (2184 ± 519 g) vs GDMA2 (2438 ± 428 g)
